notes: One Spanish-language circular with five AI-use levels; both coders found the same units (59 of 62 and 68 matched). Dropped none: all 3 A-only units (extra Level 2 permission, instructor choose-and-adapt level, sanctions per regulation) and all 9 B-only units (examples-style permissions, pre-task limit, Level 2 rationale, critical-thinking duty, sample language, acceptable-use norms) are real statements in the circular and were kept.
